purpose: Native evidence for signed labels on FLOAT file-model component pins (A4). amp_float_signed.son is the installed amp.son example with the SPARAM component's GNDREF records set to FLOAT and its second pin's geometry label changed from 4 to -3, forming project differential port 3. Sonnet Lite 18.53 ingests the signed FLOAT file-model pin grammar and halts only at its data-file-component license wall, recorded in native_em_stderr.log. Pin-level semantics are anchored by the installed rfid_tag_pro example: its FLOAT RFID_CHIP component declares SMDP labels +1 and -1 on pin indices 1 and 2 — the negative label marks the pin as the return side of its differential port while remaining its own file-model terminal.
